column1: # Authored curriculum skills. Grammar and morphology skills remain generated.
# `function` rows carry only what is Spanish about them. Their description and
# prerequisites come from ../capabilities.tsv, which is shared with every other
# language so the graph cannot fork. Any other kind is language-specific and
# keeps its full row: a pattern is how *this* language works.
# The last column is an override, used where Spanish can be more concrete than a
# neutral description can: naming ¿verdad? is worth more to a learner here than
# "a tag question", and worthless to a learner of English. Leave it blank and the
# registry's description is the gloss. Restating that description is rejected.
